description: GHA- Dams is a data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by IGAD_DRM. OpenStreetMap contributors use tags to add metadata to dam features. Common tags include dam=yes and waterway=dam to indicate a dam, along with other details like name, name:en (for English name), name:fr (for French name), name:rn (for Rundi name), covered (if covered), width, depth, layer, blockage, tunnel, and natural=water. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher IGAD_DRM. The portal shows 2025-05-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
